Assuming **Caribbean and Latin America includes Mexico**, the hotel brands most commonly considered for a mixed hotel and for-sale branded-residences project fall into the following groups:

| Positioning | Brands commonly shortlisted |
|---|---|
| **Ultra-luxury / trophy resort** | **Four Seasons, Rosewood, Aman, One&Only, Mandarin Oriental, Ritz-Carlton Reserve, Raffles, Six Senses** |
| **Established luxury** | **The Ritz-Carlton, St. Regis, Waldorf Astoria, Park Hyatt, Fairmont, Montage, Auberge Collection** |
| **Luxury lifestyle / design-led** | **W Hotels, EDITION, Andaz, Thompson Hotels, The Standard, Pendry, SLS, Mondrian, SO/, Nobu** |
| **Broader luxury / upper-upscale** | **JW Marriott, The Luxury Collection, Conrad, LXR, InterContinental, Kimpton, Sofitel, MGallery, Viceroy** |
| **Wellness- or nature-oriented** | **Six Senses, Aman, One&Only, Auberge, Banyan Tree, Miraval, 1 Hotels** |

### Major operator groups to approach

- **Marriott International:** Ritz-Carlton, Ritz-Carlton Reserve, St. Regis, W, EDITION, JW Marriott and The Luxury Collection are the most relevant. Marriott has one of the broadest luxury-brand platforms and a long-established residential business. ([marriott.com](https://www.marriott.com/luxury/about-us?utm_source=openai))
- **Four Seasons:** Usually one of the first brands considered for high-end resort communities, especially villas, estate homes and low-density residences. Its regional residential footprint includes Mexico, the Bahamas, Anguilla, Nevis, Puerto Rico, Costa Rica, Belize, Colombia and the Dominican Republic. ([fourseasons.com](https://www.fourseasons.com/residences/private_residences/portfolio-map/?utm_source=openai))
- **Rosewood:** Particularly relevant for intimate, ultra-luxury resorts with strong architecture and sense of place. Regional examples include residential offerings in Mexico, the Bahamas, Bermuda, the British Virgin Islands and Brazil. ([rosewoodhotels.com](https://www.rosewoodhotels.com/en/media/press/2020/rosewood-hotels-resorts-continues-global-growth-with-rosewood-residences-a-life-without-reservations.html?utm_source=openai))
- **Hilton:** Waldorf Astoria is the principal ultra-luxury candidate, followed by Conrad and, selectively, LXR. Hilton has a dedicated branded-residential platform covering luxury through lifestyle positioning. ([hilton.com](https://www.hilton.com/en/corporate/residential-development/?utm_source=openai))
- **Hyatt:** Park Hyatt, Andaz, Thompson and The Standard are the main residential candidates; Miraval can fit a wellness-led project. Hyatt has more than 50 branded-residential projects open or in its pipeline and has been expanding the model in Mexico. ([newsroom.hyatt.com](https://newsroom.hyatt.com/may-30-2025-unscriptedbyhyatt?utm_source=openai))
- **Accor/Ennismore:** Fairmont, Raffles, SLS, Mondrian, SO/, Sofitel, MGallery and Faena provide a wide spectrum from traditional luxury to highly lifestyle-oriented products. Accor already has residential projects under several of these brands in Mexico, the Bahamas, Argentina and Uruguay. ([accor-residences.com](https://accor-residences.com/?utm_source=openai))
- **IHG:** Six Senses is particularly relevant for environmentally sensitive or wellness-oriented resorts; Regent targets upper luxury; Kimpton and InterContinental can work for larger or more urban mixed-use schemes. IHG’s regional residential pipeline includes Belize, Mexico, Cayman Islands and Monterrey. ([ihg.com](https://www.ihg.com/regent/content/gb/en/residences?utm_source=openai))
- **Independent luxury operators:** One&Only, Aman, Montage/Pendry and Auberge are frequently considered for distinctive, lower-density resort communities. All have relevant hotel-residential experience in Mexico or the Caribbean. ([oneandonlyresorts.com](https://www.oneandonlyresorts.com/private-homes/mandarina?utm_source=openai))

### Practical first-round shortlist by development type

**Secluded ultra-luxury beach or island resort**
- Four Seasons  
- Rosewood  
- Aman  
- One&Only  
- Ritz-Carlton Reserve  
- Six Senses  
- Auberge  

**Larger luxury resort or golf/master-planned community**
- Ritz-Carlton  
- St. Regis  
- Waldorf Astoria  
- Four Seasons  
- Fairmont  
- Park Hyatt  
- Montage  
- Mandarin Oriental  

**Lifestyle beachfront or urban mixed-use project**
- W  
- EDITION  
- Andaz  
- Thompson  
- Pendry  
- SLS  
- Mondrian  
- SO/  
- Nobu  

**Luxury project needing somewhat broader buyer recognition**
- Conrad  
- JW Marriott  
- The Luxury Collection  
- LXR  
- Kimpton  
- InterContinental  
- Sofitel or MGallery  

In practice, a developer would normally narrow this universe to **8–12 brands** based on location, targeted residential pricing, hotel ADR, number and type of residences, rental-program structure, brand availability, owner-benefit package and required management economics. The strongest brand for the hotel is not automatically the strongest brand for selling the residences.
